purpose: This medication is used to treat tension headaches, which are the kind that feel like a tight band squeezing around your head. It combines three different ingredients that each work in their own way to help relieve your headache pain. Doctors may sometimes prescribe it for other types of pain as well.
how_it_works: Butalbital is a mild sedative that helps relax the muscle contractions that can cause tension headaches. Acetaminophen, which you may know as Tylenol, helps reduce pain and lower fever. Caffeine helps boost the pain-relieving effects of the other ingredients and can also help by narrowing blood vessels in your head that may be causing discomfort.
common_side_effects: You may feel drowsy, dizzy, or lightheaded after taking this medication. Some people experience nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, or feel a little short of breath. You might also feel relaxed or even a little intoxicated, especially when you first start taking it.
warnings: This medication can be habit-forming, so it is very important to take only the amount your doctor prescribed and not use it more often than directed. Taking too much acetaminophen can seriously harm your liver, so avoid alcohol and other products that contain acetaminophen while using this medication. Using it too frequently — more than 2-3 days per week — can actually cause more headaches over time, which is called medication overuse headache or rebound headache. Do not drive or operate heavy machinery until you know how this medication affects you.
typical_dosing: The usual adult dose is 1 to 2 tablets or capsules taken every 4 hours as needed, but you should not take more than 6 tablets or capsules in a single day. Always follow exactly what your doctor tells you. Do not take it more often or in larger amounts than prescribed.
